M-ENGINE-REGISTRY.Purpose: Central catalog and lifecycle manager of active WidgetEngine instances keyed by unique strings, enabling deterministic multi-engine addressing for tests, scripts, and runtime hosts.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: EngineRegistry static class: GetOrCreate, Get, TryGet, Release, Contains, List, Clear.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Engine lifecycle coordination: automatic registration and explicit Shutdown upon release.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Per-frame pipeline execution — owned by M-WIDGET-ENGINE.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Host rect routing and rendering facade — owned by M-FVUI.

Principles.PRIN-001: No zombie engines: Release triggers WidgetEngine.Shutdown() and drops references so hosts are collectable.
Principles.PRIN-002: Idempotent acquisition: GetOrCreate returns the existing live engine or registers a new instance atomically.
Principles.PRIN-003: Read purity: Get, TryGet, Contains, and List never mutate engine state or trigger reconciliations.

Requirements.REQ-001: Key validation: Every key must be a non-null, non-whitespace string; invalid keys throw ArgumentException.
Requirements.REQ-002: GetOrCreate(key) returns the existing WidgetEngine for key if present; otherwise creates new WidgetEngine(key), registers it, and returns the instance.
Requirements.REQ-003: Get(key) returns the registered WidgetEngine instance, or null if the key is not registered. It MUST NOT throw KeyNotFoundException.
Requirements.REQ-004: TryGet(key, out WidgetEngine engine) returns true and assigns engine if found; otherwise assigns null and returns false.
Requirements.REQ-005: Release(key) invokes WidgetEngine.Shutdown() on the matching engine and removes it from the catalog, returning true. Releasing an unregistered key returns false without throwing.
Requirements.REQ-006: Contains(key) returns true if an engine with the given key is currently registered, false otherwise.
Requirements.REQ-007: List() returns an immutable snapshot (IReadOnlyCollection<WidgetEngine>) of all currently live engines.
Requirements.REQ-008: Clear() invokes Shutdown() on every registered engine and empties the registry.
Requirements.REQ-009: Thread-safety: Registry operations are thread-safe (e.g. backed by ConcurrentDictionary<string, WidgetEngine> or lock).

Inputs.IN-001: key: string — stable unique identifier of the UI context (e.g., "window:trade", "gizmo:draft").

Outputs.OUT-001: WidgetEngine — resolved or newly instantiated engine instance.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Mutates registry state; invokes Shutdown on released engines.

M-ENGINE-REGISTRY.Codemap: * `EngineRegistry.{GetOrCreate|Get|TryGet|Release|Contains|List|Clear}` * `EngineRegistry.GetOrCreate(key)` -> `new WidgetEngine(key)` => cache * `EngineRegistry.Release(key)` -> `WidgetEngine.Shutdown()` => remove * `EngineRegistry` <= `FVUI.Render` + `FVUI.Release` + external inspection (Lua / REPL / tests)
